evidenceNeeded: real customer DNS ownership, custom hostname registration, and managed TLS receipt
note: Browser origin proof does not provision DNS or certificates.
requirement: A real customer-controlled hostname routes to the owner runtime over valid HTTPS

evidenceNeeded: edge Host-to-tenant allowlist, revocation, and unauthorized-host rejection receipt
note: Client-side audience verification is fail-closed runtime policy, not copy protection or edge authorization.
requirement: The delivery edge binds allowed hostnames to tenants and can revoke them without app redeploy

evidenceNeeded: real hosted module conformance covering CSP frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, redirects, failure fallback, and optional CORS
note: Playwright route fulfillment proves browser boundaries without claiming every live external URL is embeddable.
requirement: A production external URL module satisfies the published embedding and lifecycle contract

evidenceNeeded: production KMS or HSM key custody, rotation, public-key cutover, and policy revocation receipts
note: Repository fixtures use an explicitly non-production test private key.
requirement: Publication signatures use production key custody and a tested rotation and revocation path

evidenceNeeded: Firefox and Safari compatibility plus accessibility, focus, and print acceptance receipts
requirement: Supported non-Chromium browsers and presentation accessibility behavior pass acceptance
